directConnection.title: Enable direct connection?
directConnection.message:
A direct connection to this device could not be established. On some networks (e.g. mesh WiFi), browsers hide your local address until you grant camera or microphone access once.

The camera is not actually used – granting access only lets the browser share your local network address with the other device. Files then transfer directly: faster and with no size limit.

general.heading: 1. General
general.text: The protection of your personal data is an important concern for the operator of this website. This website can generally be used without an account and without actively entering personal data.

dataProcessing.heading: 2. Processing of Personal Data
dataProcessing.intro: No user accounts are maintained and no data is stored permanently. The following connection data is processed temporarily for technical purposes:
dataProcessing.item1: IP address for the duration of the connection
dataProcessing.item2: Session ID (sessionId) and device name for pairing devices
dataProcessing.volatile: This data is processed exclusively in a volatile manner and is not persisted.
dataProcessing.noTracking: No analysis or tracking tools are used, and no cookies are set for marketing or analysis purposes.

transferredContent.heading: 3. Transferred Content (Photos)
transferredContent.intro: Photos transferred via this website serve exclusively for temporary transfer between connected devices.
transferredContent.item1: The transferred data is not stored permanently.
transferredContent.item2: There is no disclosure to third parties (except to the counterpart you have connected).
transferredContent.item3: The transfer is end-to-end encrypted; the server only sees encrypted payloads.

scope.text: These Terms of Service govern the use of the website FileBeacon and the functions provided for transferring images between devices. By using this service, you agree to these Terms of Service.

serviceDescription.text: FileBeacon enables the temporary transfer of images between connected devices via a web interface. The service is provided without registration and without permanent storage of the transferred content. There is no entitlement to specific functions or permanent availability (best-effort).

ownResponsibility.heading: 3. Use at Your Own Risk
